pillars.title: Build Competitively
pillars.desc: Design and fabricate industry-grade robots using the DHF engineering framework — data-driven, FMEA-tested, and built to compete at the highest level.

pillars.title: Reach Outward
pillars.desc: Bring meaningful STEM access to communities that need it most — Children's Wisconsin, the Milwaukee VA, computer donation programs, and beyond.

pillars.title: Develop People
pillars.desc: Grow the next generation of engineers, designers, and leaders through real challenges, a strong mentorship pipeline, and fully student-led decision making.

pillars.title: Sustain FIRST
pillars.desc: Actively grow the FIRST ecosystem in Wisconsin — hosting rookie qualifiers, mentoring FLL teams, and building CNCs for resource-limited programs.

principles: Data over opinion — every design decision is backed by testing, FMEA, or Monte Carlo simulation.
Simplicity over complexity — if the simplest solution works, that's the right solution.
Sustainability over short-term wins — we build systems and culture that last beyond any one season.
Outreach is strategic — every program we run is intentional and tied to measurable community impact.
Continuous improvement — two-week sprints, retrospectives, and goal tracking keep us moving forward.
Collaboration over competition — we share openly with other teams because growing the ecosystem grows everyone.
